name: @lenticule-science/weiqi-web
description: Static web face for a normal 9x9 Weiqi match, lessons, and glossary reading, built on the exact-pinned shared Weiqi engine.

deliberateEntries.reason: A browser-served bundle generated from weiqi-engine's src/index.mjs by scripts/build-kernel.mjs and named as the "browser-engine" artifact in scripts/public-release-contract.mjs.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-kernel.mjs && node scripts/build-glossary.mjs && node scripts/build-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-service-worker.mjs
scripts.check: for f in public/js/*.mjs public/js/kernel/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs src/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && node --test 'test/*.test.mjs'
